svg.title: 2026-07-28T00-02-02-696Z-publication-clean-openai-low binary discovery trace
svg.desc: Chronological binary threshold discovery for gpt-4.1 and fact_only. Independent contexts and probe phases are separated visually; lines are drawn only across comparable binary-search points. The y-axis is log-scaled refund amount. Green marks LOW, red marks NOT_LOW, and light gray marks invalid output.
svg.text: Run: 2026-07-28T00-02-02-696Z-publication-clean-openai-low. Context: fact_only. Y-axis is logarithmic dollars.
